detailed_description:
The target video uses a photo-studio live-action style with a locked head-and-shoulders close-up and a snappy, playful rhythm.

[Shot 1] The shot begins from the first cell of <Picture 1>, a bright laughing expression: <Subject 1> looks into the camera, the corners of her mouth lifting and then snapping into a full bright laugh - mouth wide open showing teeth, eyes squeezed into crescents, brows raised, and cheeks lifted by the smile. The silver hoops bounce slightly with her head. A crisp shutter click fires in sync.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.111, the shot cuts to the second cell of <Picture 1>, a frowning dislike expression: <Subject 1>'s brows knit downward and inward, her mouth pulled firmly down into an inverted U, and her gaze dropping down toward the camera. Her cheeks press slightly downward. Another shutter click fires.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.222, the shot cuts to the third cell of <Picture 1>, a sulky pitiful expression: <Subject 1>'s brows lightly knit, the corners of her mouth pulled down, and her eyes looking up toward the camera from beneath her lashes.  her lower lip juts forward slightly, and her posture shrinks inward.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.333, the shot cuts to the fourth cell of <Picture 1>, an O-mouth surprise expression: <Subject 1>'s eyes snap wide, her brows lift to their highest, and her mouth opens into a perfect O. The sulky mood flips instantly into surprise.

[Shot 5] At 00:04.444, the shot cuts to the fifth cell of <Picture 1>, a scared fright expression: <Subject 1>'s brows knot into an eight-shaped frown, her brow line pressing low, mouth half-open showing lower teeth, eyes round and slightly glassy, shoulders pulled slightly inward. The whole body reads as a tight, nervous flinch.

[Shot 6] At 00:05.555, the shot cuts to the sixth cell of <Picture 1>, a drowsy half-asleep expression: <Subject 1> closes one eye to a slit, the other eye half-shutters, the corners of her mouth slacken downward, and her head tilts slightly to one side. Her look is lazy and dreamy, as if she is about to drift off.

[Shot 7] At 00:06.666, the shot cuts to the seventh cell of <Picture 1>, an eyes-closed sweet smile: <Subject 1>'s eyes are fully closed, the corners of her mouth lift to reveal small dimples, her cheeks puff up gently, and her expression reads as soft, warm, and quiet.

[Shot 8] At 00:07.777, the shot cuts to the eighth cell of <Picture 1>, an eye-roll disdain expression: <Subject 1> rolls both eyes up and to one side, exposing a sliver of white beneath her irises, one corner of her mouth pulls sideways into a cold half-smirk, and her chin lifts slightly. The whole look reads as too-bored-to-deal-with-you disdain.

[Shot 9] At 00:08.888, the shot cuts to the ninth cell of <Picture 1>, a playful smirk, used as the final shot: <Subject 1>'s mouth tilts to one side, her eyes slant to the opposite side, one corner of her mouth lifted, one brow raised. The whole mood reads as cute and playful. The video stops on this playful smirk and fades out.

overall_soundscape: Photo-studio air-conditioning white noise runs continuously throughout. Each expression switch fires a crisp shutter click - nine snappy clicks in rapid succession. A single low shutter sound closes the video before the room falls quiet.

non_diegetic_music: A playful fast electronic track at roughly 130 BPM, led by pluck synth, snappy lo-fi drum kit, and occasional slap-bass accents. Each expression switch lands a beat accent synchronized with the shutter click. The volume pulls down over the final second, leaving room for the playful smirk to land with a breath of quiet.
